description: Pure Homomorphic Encryption ablation — PARTIAL model coverage. Only the classifier head (~3.6% of parameters) is CKKS-encrypted client-side; the remaining ~96.4% (CNN + LSTM backbone) is sent as plaintext and aggregated via standard FedAvg on the server.

data_provenance.source: AUTHORITATIVE — read directly from results/he_partial/client_0_results.json, client_1_results.json, and server_timing.json, as provided verbatim by the user. Supersedes the earlier console-reconstructed version of this manifest.
data_provenance.confidence: exact — all figures below are copied directly from the source JSON

feature_count.confirmed_by: num_features: 35 field directly inside both client_0 and client_1's recorded config block — authoritative, identical partition files to the he_full condition

why_this_differs_from_the_main_experimen.main_experiment_source: src/data_loader.py's load_partition_network(), called by main.py (Krum/DP-SGD experiments), fit on the FULL corpus (~736,046 rows, no row cap)
why_this_differs_from_the_main_experimen.this_run_source: docker_fl/build_partitions.py, invoked with --max-rows 100000 per the script's documented usage example, producing a ~100k-row stratified subsample of the corpus BEFORE VarianceThreshold(threshold=1e-6) is fit
why_this_differs_from_the_main_experimen.root_cause: Identical mechanism to the he_full condition — VarianceThreshold's selected feature set is sample-size-dependent, and a ~100k-row stratified subsample causes several borderline-variance columns to fall below the 1e-6 threshold that clears on the full 736,046-row corpus. Both conditions share the exact same partition files, so this discrepancy is identical and not condition-specific.
why_this_differs_from_the_main_experimen.resolution_status: NOT YET RESOLVED as of this manifest. Same fix as he_full: rebuild via 'python build_partitions.py --model-type network --num-clients 2' (no --max-rows).

model_config.note: identical total_params to he_full, as expected — HE coverage scope changes which parameters are encrypted, not model architecture

he_config.note_on_percentage: 3.6% (4,680 / 129,352) is empirically measured, superseding earlier project-doc estimates (~5.8%, ~6%) based on a different, unreconciled total-parameter assumption. Use 3.6% / 4,680 / 129,352 as authoritative going forward.

dp_config_present_but_inactive.note: argparse defaults recorded regardless of use_dp; dp_method: null confirms DP did not execute

resource_limits.CONFIRMED_MISMATCH: same as he_full — client.py's config.mem_limit_mb reads 200 for both clients here too, contradicting the 500m actually enforced. Peak usage of ~365-373MB in this run would have exceeded a genuine 200MB limit; the absence of an OOM kill confirms 500m was the real active limit. This is a pre-existing client.py labeling bug shared identically across both HE conditions.

1.note: he_encrypt stage_peaks/stage_avgs of 0.0 here reflects the HE stage's RamSampler capturing essentially no samples during this round's very brief (~0.03s) encryption window at this sampling interval — not a measurement error, just an artifact of an extremely short stage relative to the sampler's polling interval
